name: Countdown balloon
summary: Large gold foil number balloon showing a digit 0 to 9, for countdowns and birthday or anniversary numbers. Anim bob.

params.name: y
params.note: y of the knot; the numeral rises about 350 px above it

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the numeral is about 350 px tall

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down with a slight tilt
